note: Give the change analysis a defined record/kind the delta step writes and feature route, story-writer and the spec packet read.
Define a step-name grammar (or step-kind field) so the verdict can find a unit's review passes, fixes and arbitration.
Define which commit the cycle's base is, record it in cycle.json, and cut story branches from it.
Specify the local-mode merge (detached worktree plus ff-only of a clean main checkout, awaiting_merge when dirty) as one stated exception.
Grant builders git-read for status/diff/log and make an absent commands key mean none, not every family.
Reconcile the closed hooks key list with the documented keys (log_retention_days, strength, secret_globs, purity patterns) so a B3 loader accepts them.
Define 'live run' for step-results and spec_locked so lock-less workflows (discover, maintain, spike) can store records and a crashed amendment unlocks.
Make the story-kind table the single source mapping kind to implement agent and method, and fix the @repo-setup default mismatch.
Narrow the core scope to the project's build and test commands per D4 instead of every configured command.
Align the checkpoint signature with the scripts' call (add --subject or drop it from story.js/wave.js).
Add review_rules to the story unit and rounds_used to the survey result so reviewer prompts and the wave cap see real values.
Define limits.gate_minutes and ci_minutes (or rename the survey's keys) before the unknown-limit-key check bites.
Namespace the two review loops' step records (delivery repair vs main loop) and define store_step overwrite/refuse behaviour.
Carry the builder's dispute notes through converge/arbitrate into the arbiter's packet instead of dropping them.
Make a re-freeze record carry the full frozen set (delta plus survivors) and state its gate name is red.
Define the stub marker (string or convention) the green gate checks, toolchain-independently.
Fix the agent-file standard so the key list includes omitClaudeMd (and spike-runner isolation) and the example matches the lint.
Unify spike command forms (step with attempt, --id on record, runSpike's --step) across pipeline, state and the prelude.
Add --amend, severity and intent to the feature survey's options so the route (amend vs queue, release-tag cut) is decidable.
Confine --wait to job commands or teach feature route to accept it, so brief()'s appended --wait 540 is not a usage error.
Put --version in a group every caller holds (or exempt it) so smoke probe 6 passes gate-guard.
Split the measure group or add per-command caller rows so only the stated callers run gate wave --settle and gate plan --story.
State how write check 2 treats nested path classes so product-owner and architect can write brief, conventions and review-rules files.

Redefine the lock-refresh fallback so main-session story steps (cwd at project root, reviewers shell-less) keep a live run's lock fresh. The refresh on a vsdd call, a step result and a Bash call in a story worktree is built (hook-runner-b). What is left is the read-only reviewer: when H3 wires Read and Grep, a Read or Grep in the locked run's story worktree, from a second session with an agent id, must refresh the lock, with a test (plan decision D2 of rewrite/plans/step-3/hook-runner-b.md).
State one local-delivery rule (detached merge, ff-only clean checkout, awaiting_merge dirty) with a G4a fixture for both checkout states.
Define the caller's worktree from the target path or -C prefix (never payload cwd), key markers by session+argv hash, and let --run calls refresh the lock.
Amend the slice order: run B8 probes 6/27-31/34 first, add C2, the roster part of B6 and S4 (or split H7) to layer 1.
Add commands.fidelity/fuzz/coverage, a coverage threshold, [perf] regression_pct and a hub integration command so the measured checks are runnable; say who records the real service's behaviour.
Add a tests_method story key applied to the tests stage, make every method reachable (claude-md, release-notes, devops observability), and lint reachability.
Make the checkpoint run the configured notify channel (issue or command) when it opens a decision, and assign the work to S3.
State the permission decision paired with a rewritten vsdd call (allow when auto-allow permits, ask otherwise) and fix item 7's static rules to match the prefixed command.
Order spike admission before the runner's first spike open: claim the oldest unclaimed session admission, or pair in a synchronous PreToolUse rule.
Probe and record the four assumed platform facts (plugin-root substitution, final message, fork background, MCP tool lists) and set background: false on research/retro.
Drop --subject from the prelude's checkpoint calls (the run record knows its subject) or add it to the signature.
Correct the seam mapping rows: staleness/vsdd-stale dropped (digest plus lock), ingest ends at decision spec, lessons are a retrospective report.
Add the storybook MCP registration step to setup (with a doctor check when project.ui) or drop the storybook lists from the four agents.
State that a person creates and protects the remote (with a doctor line when delivery.mode stays local) or have setup offer to create it.
Pin the sample's commands to uv run --no-project --offline, no build-system, stdlib lint/format, and .venv in .gitignore; assert no network fetch.
Key liveness to run-attributed calls, allow same-session survey re-entry to take over, and define lock release semantics (own/stale/force).
Require a passing red record per red-gated kind, have step-results verify each gates[] entry against its evidence record, and inspect Bash writes in tests-first.
Define the local merge path (branch-checked-out worktree if clean, checkout_dirty otherwise, detached worktree when checked out nowhere) and amend the never-touch invariant wording.
Narrow git-read to read-only subcommands, add a git-ref family no agent holds, list builder commands explicitly, and refuse delivery when the integration head is foreign.
Add method to the step identity so a pass counts only when its method is a review method owned by the stored agent type in the roster.
Import rule modules inside the per-rule try, name the quarantine restart command in the block fix line, and surface repeated rule.error in status and briefing.
Have feature/wave/verify/maintain surveys re-record every undelivered story admitted to the open cycle in the new run, so resumed children pass their gates.
Extend the done test to earlier crashed runs' validated records and have the feature survey mark the amendment when no approved spec decision of its own exists.
After a cap run one guided fix plus pass (direct), apply settled waivers in the tool's verdict, and put the person's guidance in every brief.
Add a stale-spec-decision route row: the next survey or checkpoint opens a new spec decision listing changed files, briefed as a state problem.
Add lint/format/scan report keys with a finding identity (tool, rule, path, line-text hash) so only new findings block; fall back to exit status otherwise.
Record whether baseline identities were measured and re-measure on harness delivery, unify the readiness condition, and stop counting inherited tests a story fixed as inherited.
Fetch and fast-forward the state branch before survey preconditions, and add a fresh lease so two machines cannot run one wave.
Settling open-spike also writes the named-spike request; the unit stays blocked on that spike and spike close feeds the finding back.
Approve configured commands only as one plain segment (no separators, substitutions, eval, xargs, redirects); mark opaque commands and never auto-allow them.
Extend the default credential globs (git-credentials, cargo, pypirc, gem, kube, gcloud, azure, terraform, gnupg) and block gh auth --show-token and git credential helpers.
On uv rc 2, discriminate the three causes (no interpreter, unwritable cache, old uv) with one uv python find and uv --version, and print the matching fix.
Probe hook timeouts (shell watchdog exiting 2 if needed), give the final-message check the gate deadline, and announce rule.timeout in the briefing.
Print the driver instruction whenever driver.json names this session, with or without a live lock.
Refresh the lock on StructuredOutput with step.run and vsdd --run calls, and probe whether workflows survive /clear before releasing on SessionEnd.
Validate StructuredOutput against the step-result (and data) schema with schema.py, block invalid results once, and record the platform's validation ordering.
Carry a fix story's disputed keys into the wave fix() as disputed so the arbiter can dismiss findings after a cap.
On SessionStart only, print one line when a remote factory-artifacts ref exists but the state is unmounted, extending D24's exception.
Queue the request as requests/CR-NNN.md and return queued before attempting the lock when another cycle is active and the request is not critical.
Allow recursive deletion only of build output in the caller's own worktree and reserve worktree removal for the tool, with a sibling-worktree case.
